# Create the plot of predictive values and confidente intervales of LMM models
 
 
# Rho ~ Elo score
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
 
 
# Create a sequence between min and max Elo score of LMM models
elo_seq <- seq(min(data_norm$elo, na.rm = TRUE), max(data_norm$elo, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)
 
# Add sequence of confidence intervals for intercept and Elo score variables fog rho in gains and losses from LMM models
rhog_int <- seq(from = -0.21, to = 0.13, by = 0.05)
rhog_coeff <- seq(from = -0.06, to = 0.05, by = 0.01)
rhog_coeff2 <- seq(from = 0.05, to = 0.10, by = 0.01)
 
rhol_int <- seq(from = -0.64, to = -0.45, by = 0.05)
rhol_coeff <- seq(from = -0.06, to = -0.00, by = 0.01)
rhol_coeff2 <- seq(from = 0.00, to = 0.03, by = 0.01)
 
# Create all combinations with all possible confidence intervals
combinations_rhog <- expand.grid(rhog_int = rhog_int, 
                                 rhog_coeff = rhog_coeff, 
                                 rhog_coeff2 = rhog_coeff2)
 
# Calculation of prediction values for all combination
rho_g_preds <- apply(combinations_rhog, 1, function(x) {
  rho_int <- x[1]
  coeff1 <- x[2]
  coeff2 <- x[3]
  rho_int + coeff1 * elo_seq + coeff2 * elo_seq^2
})
 
# Dataframe convertion
df_rhog <- data.frame(elo = rep(elo_seq, nrow(combinations_rhog)),
                      rho_g_pred = unlist(rho_g_preds),
                      rhog_int = rep(combinations_rhog$rhog_int, each = length(elo_seq)),
                      rhog_coeff = rep(combinations_rhog$rhog_coeff, each = length(elo_seq)),
                      rhog_coeff2 = rep(combinations_rhog$rhog_coeff2, each = length(elo_seq)))
 
df_rhog_long <- df_rhog %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("rho_g_pred"), 
               names_to = "step", 
               values_to = "value")
 
 
 
# The same for rho in losses
combinations_rhol <- expand.grid(rhol_int = rhol_int, 
                                 rhol_coeff = rhol_coeff, 
                                 rhol_coeff2 = rhol_coeff2)
 
rho_l_preds <- apply(combinations_rhol, 1, function(x) {
  rho_int <- x[1]
  coeff1 <- x[2]
  coeff2 <- x[3]
  rho_int + coeff1 * elo_seq + coeff2 * elo_seq^2
})
 
df_rhol <- data.frame(elo = rep(elo_seq, nrow(combinations_rhol)),
                      rho_l_pred = unlist(rho_l_preds),
                      rhol_int = rep(combinations_rhol$rhol_int, each = length(elo_seq)),
                      rhol_coeff = rep(combinations_rhol$rhol_coeff, each = length(elo_seq)),
                      rhol_coeff2 = rep(combinations_rhol$rhol_coeff2, each = length(elo_seq)))
 
df_rhol_long <- df_rhol %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("rho_l_pred"), 
               names_to = "step", 
               values_to = "value")
 
 
 
# Keep only extreme values for each Elo score values for rho in gains to plot the confidence intervals
df_rhog_long_extreme <- df_rhog_long %>%
  group_by(elo) %>%
  summarise(
    ymin = min(value),
    ymax = max(value)
  ) %>%
  mutate(group = "Rho_g")
 
# Keep only extreme values for each Elo score values for rho in losses to plot the confidence intervals
df_rhol_long_extreme <- df_rhol_long %>%
  group_by(elo) %>%
  summarise(
    ymin = min(value),
    ymax = max(value)
  ) %>%
  mutate(group = "Rho_l")
 
# Dataframe fusion
df_combined <- bind_rows(df_rhog_long_extreme, df_rhol_long_extreme)
 
# Define "adult" as referential age category
data_norm$age_category <- relevel(data_norm$age_category, ref = "adult")
 
# LMM models to plot the prediction value for rho in function of Elo score
h4 <- lmer(rho_g ~ age_category + sex + elo + I(elo^2) + mean_trial_number + (1|monkey), data = data_norm)
h5 <- lmer(rho_l ~ age_category + sex + elo + I(elo^2) + mean_trial_number + (1|monkey), data = data_norm)
 
# Coefficients extraction
coefs_g <- summary(h4)$coefficients[, "Estimate"]
 
coefs_l <- summary(h5)$coefficients[, "Estimate"]
 
# Elo score sequence
elo_seq <- seq(min(data_norm$elo, na.rm = TRUE), max(data_norm$elo, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)
 
# Predictive values calculation for rho in gains
rho_g_pred <- coefs_g["(Intercept)"] + coefs_g["elo"] * elo_seq + coefs_g["I(elo^2)"] * elo_seq^2
# Predictive values calculation for rho in gains
rho_l_pred <- coefs_l["(Intercept)"] + coefs_l["elo"] * elo_seq + coefs_l["I(elo^2)"] * elo_seq^2
 
 
# Creation of predictive values dataframe 
df_modeles <- data.frame(
  elo = elo_seq,
  rho_g_pred = rho_g_pred,
  rho_l_pred = rho_l_pred 
)
 
# Plot of predictive values with confiences intervales of LMM models
ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = df_combined, aes(x = elo, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = group), alpha = 0.3) +  
  geom_line(data = df_modeles, aes(x = elo, y = rho_g_pred, linetype = "rho_g"), color = "skyblue", size = 1.2) +  
  geom_line(data = df_modeles, aes(x = elo, y = rho_l_pred, linetype = "rho_l"), color = "orange", size = 1.2) +   
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, size = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Rho_g" = "skyblue", "Rho_l" = "orange")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("rho_g" = "solid", "rho_l" = "dashed")) +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "Normalized value for Elo score",
       y = expression(rho ~ " predicted value")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 26),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 26),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm")
  ) + 
  ylim(-1.12, 1)
```

# Rho ~ Trial number
```{r}
mean_trial_number_seq <- seq(min(data_norm$mean_trial_number, na.rm = TRUE), max(data_norm$mean_trial_number, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)
 
rhog_int <- seq(from = -0.21, to = 0.13, by = 0.01)

rhol_coeff <- seq(from = 0.01, to = 0.03, by = 0.005)

rho_g_preds <- apply(combinations_rhog, 1, function(x) {
  rho_int <- x[1]
  coeff <- x[2]
  rho_int + coeff * mean_trial_number_seq
})

                      rho_g_pred = unlist(rho_g_preds),

  coeff <- x[2]
  rho_int + coeff * mean_trial_number_seq
```

# Lambda ~ Elo score

```{r}
# Séquence ELO
elo_seq <- seq(min(data_norm$elo, na.rm = TRUE),
               max(data_norm$elo, na.rm = TRUE),
               length.out = 100)

# Plages de coefficients
lambda_int <- seq(from = 1.00, to = 1.81, by = 0.05)
lambda_coeff <- seq(from = -0.28, to = -0.05, by = 0.01)
lambda_coeff2 <- seq(from = -0.31, to = -0.20, by = 0.01)

# Combinaisons (taille gérable)
combinations_lambda <- expand.grid(lambda_int = lambda_int, 
                                   lambda_coeff = lambda_coeff, 
                                   lambda_coeff2 = lambda_coeff2)

# Calcul des prédictions de manière sûre et rapide avec purrr::pmap
library(purrr)
lambda_preds <- pmap_dfr(combinations_lambda, function(lambda_int, lambda_coeff, lambda_coeff2) {
  tibble(
    elo = elo_seq,
    value = lambda_int + lambda_coeff * elo_seq + lambda_coeff2 * elo_seq^2
  )
}, .id = "combination_id")

# Calcul des bornes min/max pour le ruban
df_lambda_long_extreme <- lambda_preds %>%
  group_by(elo) %>%
  summarise(
    ymin = min(value),
    ymax = max(value)
  ) %>%
  mutate(group = "Lambda")

# Modèle linéaire mixte
h4 <- lmer(lambda_ ~ age_category + sex + elo + I(elo^2) + mean_trial_number + (1 | monkey),
           data = data_norm)

coefs_g <- summary(h4)$coefficients[, "Estimate"]

# Prédictions du modèle ajusté
lambda_pred <- coefs_g["(Intercept)"] +
  coefs_g["elo"] * elo_seq +
  coefs_g["I(elo^2)"] * elo_seq^2

df_modeles <- data.frame(
  elo = elo_seq,
  lambda_pred = lambda_pred
)

# Graphique
ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = df_lambda_long_extreme,
              aes(x = elo, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = group),
              alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = df_modeles,
            aes(x = elo, y = lambda_pred, linetype = "lambda_"),
            color = "#D62728", size = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, size = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Lambda" = "#D62728")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("lambda_" = "solid")) +
  labs(
    x = "Normalized value for Elo score",
    y = expression(lambda ~ " predicted value")
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 26),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 26),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm")
  ) +
  ylim(-1, 2.5)


```

# Lambda ~ Trial number

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# Séquence pour mean_trial_number
mean_trial_number_seq <- seq(
  min(data_norm$mean_trial_number, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(data_norm$mean_trial_number, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 100
)

# --- 1️⃣ PARAMÈTRES LAMBDA ---

lambda_int <- seq(from = 1.00, to = 1.81, by = 0.05)
lambda_coeff <- seq(from = 0.20, to = 0.30, by = 0.01)

# Combinaisons de coefficients (linéaires seulement)
combinations_lambda <- expand.grid(
  lambda_int = lambda_int,
  lambda_coeff = lambda_coeff
)

# Prédictions avec purrr::pmap_dfr() (robuste et mémoire-sûr)
lambda_preds <- pmap_dfr(combinations_lambda, function(lambda_int, lambda_coeff) {
  tibble(
    mean_trial_number = mean_trial_number_seq,
    value = lambda_int + lambda_coeff * mean_trial_number_seq
  )
}, .id = "combination_id")

# Calcul des bornes extrêmes pour le ruban
df_lambda_long_extreme <- lambda_preds %>%
  group_by(mean_trial_number) %>%
  summarise(
    ymin = min(value),
    ymax = max(value)
  ) %>%
  mutate(group = "Lambda")

# --- 2️⃣ MODÈLE LMER ---
# On garde le même modèle structurel que pour les autres variables
# (mean_trial_number n’a qu’un effet linéaire)
h_lambda <- lmer(lambda_ ~ age_category + sex + elo + I(elo^2) + mean_trial_number + (1 | monkey),
                 data = data_norm)

# Coefficients du modèle
coefs_lambda <- summary(h_lambda)$coefficients[, "Estimate"]

# Prédictions du modèle ajusté (effet linéaire uniquement)
lambda_pred <- coefs_lambda["(Intercept)"] +
  coefs_lambda["mean_trial_number"] * mean_trial_number_seq

df_modeles <- data.frame(
  mean_trial_number = mean_trial_number_seq,
  lambda_pred = lambda_pred
)

# --- 3️⃣ VISUALISATION ---
ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = df_lambda_long_extreme,
    aes(x = mean_trial_number, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = group),
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = df_modeles,
    aes(x = mean_trial_number, y = lambda_pred, linetype = "lambda_"),
    color = "#D62728", size = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, size = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Lambda" = "#D62728")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("lambda_" = "solid")) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Normalized value for mean trial number",
    y = expression(lambda ~ " predicted value")
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 26),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 26),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm")
  ) +
  ylim(-1, 2.5)

```
